notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
🎉 Big News, Little Chefs! 🎉

Today is a huge day for us! Kokoro Kitchen is officially launching on October 17th, just 4 weeks away! ✨
[previewyoutube="-FXwMdJWCLg;full"][/previewyoutube]
It feels totally surreal to be this close to the finish line. There's still a bit of polishing and cozy chaos ahead, but we’re feeling really good about where things are heading. That said, you know us. We like to keep things chill and flexible. If anything unexpected pops up and we need a little more time, we’ll keep you in the loop.



Thank you so so much for being on this journey with us. Your support means the world, and we seriously can’t wait for you to step into the warm, delicious world of Kokoro Kitchen. 🥰💕



Let the countdown begin! 



We appreciate you!

Axie & Leaf

notes.title: Playtest Patch 1.0
notes.notes:
Hey Little Chefs!
We’ve been cooking up some fixes and improvements based on your feedback so far. Thank you SO MUCH for everything you have shared up to this point. We are hoping these updates make the playtesting experience even better! Here’s what’s new in this update:

🍽️ Customer Clumping Fix

No more customer traffic jams — they should now politely navigate around each other instead of forming a mosh pit in front of your store.

🖥️ UI Scaling Improvements

We’ve tweaked screen resolutions so the UI should now behave across different screen sizes. Big screen? Small screen? Steamdeck? We got you. (Hopefully - please let us know if there are still issues!)

⌛ Chill Vibes Update

NPC order patience has been extended to help take the edge off the rush. Things should feel a bit more manageable now!

📖 Tutorial Access

We indicated some important keys on the starting screen you help you out at the beginning. You can now  also find a helpful tutorial page right in the main menu.

⛔ ESC Functionality

Pressing ESC (as well as TAB) will now bring up the menu — because that's what ESC should  do.

🌀 No More Shadow Realm Shenanigans

Plates and watering cans can no longer be yeeted into the void. RIP dimensional chaos.

🪑 Upgrade Fixes

All items can be placed on the side table now.

Takeout meals are now gated behind the proper upgrade — no sneaky early takeout action!

Thanks for playing and for all your feedback — please check out this updated version and let us know what else we can do to make the final version of this game even better! 💚

We appreciate you!
Mango Leaf Games

P.S. You shouldn't lose your earlier save, but if you do please let us know!

notes.title: Playtest Update - Soon!!
notes.notes:
Hey Little Chefs!
We have been hard at work getting things together for our first big playtest at the end of March! We got some really helpful feedback from close friends and are working hard this week to implement their suggestions before we have you all give it a try! 

Here are some of the things that we are adding to the game for the playtest:
- Character Customization: Check out some of these cute options! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302604/3f9f8b5c3fba43b17c5cc5f6ae5e7f2f37472b43.jpg We will also have other clothing and hair options for you all to play around with <3 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302604/bc7557c24063eec7346da276c1fd8da91359e01c.jpg
- Adding Some Juiciness: Working on some cozy UI indicators for when your meal is cooking, when you clear your work station, and when you assemble the meals. 
- Controller Support: Implementing some controller support as well as mouse support - since the game is really just keyboard controlled at the moment. 
- and Much More!!

We are trying to make the playtest the best it can be, while also know we can't get everything done yet. We are soooo very excited to get all your feedback!!! 

Keep your eyes on Kokoro Kitchen - Big things are coming!

Appreciate you!
Axie & Leaf

notes.title: 2025 Game Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Chefs!
Welcome to the first update from Kokoro Kitchen! We are very excited to share some new areas with you and updates on the previous spaces. This recent screenshot update includes showing off the farm, the preparation station room, the bedroom, and the starting screen. Honestly, finally having a starting screen in the game is huge - the game finally feels real!

We are working hard to give each space a little bit of juice - adding sound FX, music, little bits of animation here and there  - so that our first playtesters can get a true sense of our vision. In the coming weeks, we intended to show off a little game play video - and our to do list before then includes:
- Finalizing the day/night cycle
- Updating the merchant system - including adding in our adorable Merchant NPC
- Incorporate additional functionality for purchasing upgrades & new recipes

While many of those systems are already build out in the code (YAY Leaf! He works so hard <3), we finally have some 3D asset to use and can start actually making more recipes - like the Katsu Sandwich and all our sushi options!

As for our timeline moving forward (and when you get your hands on something playable) here is what you can expect: 
- Late March: Playtesting begins! It will likely be a little rough and we would appreciate all the feedback to help us polish it up before we release our first demo!
- Summer Steam Next Fest: First big Demo launch!! 
- October: Game release!

Please keep in mind, we both work full time while making this game and, though we put out heart and soul into it every spare minute we have, this timeline may change as life/work things take their toll.

If you are interested in being a playtester - or just hanging out with us devs - please join our Discord! (You'll find the link on our steam page).

Appreciate you!
Axie & Leaf
